Charlie Redgrave appeared at the Pavilion, Bognor Regis, in his famous turn, "A Ukelele, a Smile and a Song." Tommy Green hopes to be a frequent attender at walking fixtures and we all look forward to seeing him and Raymond, who is shortly coming out of the Navy.

Charlie Redgrave, "The Banjulele Boy", passes Alf Harley only feet from the tape to win the 1929 Boxing Day Walk Handicap. It was only a year after his election as Club "Scribe" that Alf took on the additional responsibility of Walking Hon.
(BILL) REDGRAVE We have to record with regret the death of Bill Redgrave, a Vice-President of the Club, and a member for over fifty years.
